model.name: Drawer pan/zoom: full mouse parity (touch-first)
model.description: The drawer pan/zoom is touch-first (touch is the primary design surface) but MUST work identically with a mouse: mouse-drag pans (mirrors 1-finger pan), scroll-wheel zooms (mirrors pinch-zoom), and double-click resets/toggles (mirrors double-tap). Mouse mirrors the touch behaviour exactly.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "the drawer works well on touch and it shall be touch first, but it shall also work the same way with mouse."

acceptanceCriteria.text: ★ DEVICE-ONLY (real iOS @390, Tron-verified, NEVER headless-green): touch is the primary surface — 1-finger drag pans, pinch zooms, double-tap resets/toggles. A headless browser SYNTHESIZES touch events and never exercises the real iOS gesture recognizer (no momentum, no passive-listener / touch-action conflict surfacing); this AC cannot be greened headless. Behaviour claim UNCHANGED — only the verification surface is made honest.
Mouse-drag pans the drawer content, identical to 1-finger pan. (Gated HEADLESS @390 — automatable.)
Scroll-wheel zooms the drawer content, identical to pinch-zoom (zoom toward the pointer). (Gated HEADLESS @390 — automatable.)
Double-click resets/toggles the zoom, identical to double-tap. (Gated HEADLESS @390 — automatable.)

Behaviour is identical across input types — no mouse-only or touch-only divergence in pan/zoom/reset. The MOUSE side is checkable headless; the mouse↔touch IDENTITY can only be fully confirmed on-device, since the touch half is device-only.
Verified live HEADLESS @390 for the MOUSE/pointer surface: mouse-drag pan, scroll-wheel zoom, double-click reset (AC-m1/m2/m3).

★ DEVICE-ONLY: the TOUCH gestures (1-finger pan, pinch-zoom, double-tap — AC-t) verified on real iOS @390 on Tron's device, NEVER headless-green. Headless synthesizes touch and never exercises the real gesture recognizer — so the old single AC-v ('verified headless on both surfaces') was VACUOUSLY GREEN for touch since R22.2 shipped. Corrected to honest device-only per the R40.3/R40.20 template; the requirement is NOT weakened (behaviour unchanged, verification made truthful). Tester audit: test/visual/HEADLESS-ONLY-AC-AUDIT.md.

model.crossRefNote: Extends the R21.9 rb-preview-pane / RbPanZoom pan/zoom surface with full mouse parity. ALSO cross-refs 1cbad4ef (T-iframe-pinch-scale, R19.85) per PO ruling 2026-08-09: 1cbad4ef is NOT superseded by RbPanZoom (wheel + double-tap != a 2-finger pinch) = an OPEN mobile gap. R22.2's touch pan/zoom was only ever verified by SYNTHESIZED touch (vacuous), so it is unknown whether pinch/pan actually works on Tron's 390px device. Open-gap (1cbad4ef) + vacuously-verified-neighbour (R22.2) = one story about pinch on real mobile; both require real-iOS @390 verification.
model.coverageNote: 2026-06-30 triage: the grab-bar-mouse + X-minimize bugs moved to a DEDICATED requirement R25.4 (225b18a6, sibling) per architect diagnosis + PO. The AC-grab I briefly added here was BACKED OUT to keep single-source - R22.2 stays scoped to drawer pan/zoom CONTENT mouse-parity; R25.4 owns grab-bar drag + X-minimize.
model.refinedByNote: R25.4 extends the R22.2 touch-first mouse-parity PRINCIPLE to the drawer chrome (grab-bar drag + X-minimize), which R22.2's content pan/zoom ACs did not cover.

labelCorrection.what: Split the vacuous AC-v (was 'verified live headless on both a touch and a mouse surface') into AC-v-mouse (HEADLESS @390, automatable) + AC-v-touch (DEVICE-ONLY real iOS, never headless-green); relabeled AC-t to touch-device-only. R40.3/R40.20 template. NO re-scope: behaviour claims unchanged, verification surface made honest.
